Name: Angel of the LORD
Summary: The Angel of the LORD appears across the Old Testament — to Hagar in the wilderness, to Abraham on Moriah, to Moses at the burning bush, to Gideon, to Manoah's wife, and to Jerusalem in Hezekiah's day — often speaking in the first person as God himself. Whether these appearances are a theophany, or the pre-incarnate Christ (a Christophany), is debated by scholars and theologians; this profile states the appearances and the debate without settling it.
KeyVerses: Genesis 16:7; Genesis 22:11; Exodus 3:2; Judges 6:11; Judges 13:3; 2 Kings 19:35
RelatedPeople: Hagar; Abraham; Moses; Gideon; Manoah, Father of Samson
LifeLesson: God comes close to people in their fear and failure.
